prog='''def components(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=set(); comps=[]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if g[i][j] and (i,j) not in seen:
                v=g[i][j]; stack=[(i,j)]; cells=[]
                while stack:
                    a,b=stack.pop()
                    if (a,b) in seen: continue
                    seen.add((a,b)); cells.append((a,b))
                    for x,y in ((a+1,b),(a-1,b),(a,b+1),(a,b-1)):
                        if 0<=x<h and 0<=y<w and g[x][y]==v and (x,y) not in seen:
                            stack.append((x,y))
                comps.append((v,cells))
    return comps

def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    placed=set()
    comps=components(g)
    comps.sort(key=lambda c: -min(j for _,j in c[1]))
    for v,cells in comps:
        k=0
        while True:
            newk=k+1; stop=False
            for i,j in cells:

                if nj>=w or (i,nj) in placed or (i,nj-1) in placed:

            k=newk
        for i,j in cells:
            out[i][j]=0
        for i,j in cells:

    return out
'''
